{{Top}}
'''Blueblossoms''' were [[Flower/Legends|flowers]]. They went well in a bouquet composed of [[Everlily|everlilies]], [[rojo]]s and [[purple passion]]s. Although, such an arrangement was reasonably expensive, at a cost equivalent to several days pay of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer's]] salary. [[Teela Kaarz]] received such a bouquet while being courted by [[Villian Dance]] on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
